messages:
Maya: quick sync — proposal for private deploy roadmap: split installer into profiles (minimal-airgap, vpc-controlled, relay-gateway, tenant-nat). Goal: make upgrade paths orthogonal to customer's network model. Launch criteria: 1) upgrade tests pass on tenant-nat and relay-gateway; 2) docs + migration guide; 3) egress-preservation SLOs defined. Thoughts?

Dave: re: profiles — eng ok with split but we need a stable mapping from profile -> runtime config keys. Suggest feature flags: INSTALL_PROFILE, EGRESS_MODE, RELAY_MODE. Will add CI matrix for rolling upgrades across profiles.

Elaine: field ask — multiple customers require stable egress IPs during upgrades (no burst IP churn). Also worried about NAT mapping changing for tenant-nat. Need clear rollback hooks.

Dave: relay-gateway can do static egress with --egress-mode=preserve. For tenant-nat we propose a nat-mapping export that can be consumed by customer IPAM. Quick example:
```bash
./installer apply --profile=relay-gateway --egress-mode=preserve --nat-export=true
```
This writes a mapping file to /var/lib/redwood/nat-mapping.json for ops consumption.

Samir: field customer asked for "agentless zero-downtime" upgrade. They can't run sidecars during maintenance windows. Can we provide an in-place rolling upgrade with passive proxying?

Maya: passive-proxy is feasible but adds surface area. Proposed prioritization: 1) vpc-controlled (highest ARR), 2) egress-preserve (security-sensitive), 3) tenant-nat automation (field ops). Passive-proxy as follow-up.

security: note — any egress-preserve or nat-export flow must include KMS-backed keys and an immutable audit trail. Add to launch criteria and release checklist.

deploy-bot: staging deploy kicked off for profile=vpc-controlled (job 4589) :rocket:

Dave: action items: - prototype nat-export + installer flags (owner: dave) - upgrade CI matrix for 3 profiles (owner: ci-team) - docs + migration guide outline (owner: maya) - security checklist + KMS integration (owner: security). ETA for profile=vpc-controlled MVP: ~6 weeks.

Maya: good. I'll book a 30m sync with eng + netops + field tomorrow. @elaine @dave @samir please bring at least one failing customer case per profile. Closing for now.
